## 80001 - 80033

These exceptions address discrepancies identified when values in the TESTit task do not match corresponding values present in the FLOWCAL characteristic record as of the date the task was performed.

These exceptions are generated for TESTit 3 Integrated only.

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="80001">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />80001 TI – Static pressure calibration range low does not match</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="80001">

This exception is generated when the imported Static Pressure Calibration Range Low value from TESTit does not match the corresponding value in the FLOWCAL Meter Characteristics record. For example: the TESTit value for Static Pressure Calibration Range Low is 0, but the FLOWCAL value is 14.6.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="80002">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />80002 TI – Static pressure calibration range high does not match</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="80002">

This exception is generated when the imported Static Pressure Calibration Range High value from TESTit does not match the current value in FLOWCAL Meter Characteristics. The value on the FLOWCAL characteristic record that is in effect as of the Date Performed of the TESTit Meter Inspection task will be compared to the value on the TESTit task. For example: the TESTit value for Static Pressure Calibration Range High is 500, but the FLOWCAL value is 1500.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="80030">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />80030 TI – K-factor does not match TESTit</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="80030">

This exception is generated when the imported K Factor value from TESTit does not match the current value in FLOWCAL Meter Characteristics. The value on the FLOWCAL characteristic record that is in effect as of the Date Performed of the TESTit Meter Inspection task will be compared to the value on the TESTit task. For example: the TESTit value for K Factor is 1000, but the FLOWCAL value is 1200.

</div>
